clusters.state_of_play: Germany's government, led by Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt and Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, has formally blamed Russia for an explosives-laden drone found near Ukrainian cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle airport on 4 August, calling it a hybrid attack. Germany announced countermeasures including closing Russia's consulate in Bonn and canceling the Russian House cultural contract.
